name: Trejhara Solutions Ltd
tagline: NSE: TREJHARA | Microcap enterprise software, subsidiary of Aurionpro Solutions
business_overview: Incorporated in 2017, Trejhara Solutions is a technology products/solutions provider (application software, bespoke development, infrastructure and database analysis, supply chain management) operating as a subsidiary of listed Aurionpro Solutions Ltd, serving enterprise clients across Asia, Middle East, Africa, North America and Europe.
source_notes: Source sheet noted 'recent positive results mention but lower engagement so far' - consistent with what this research found: real fundamental improvement but no dedicated ValuePickr thread yet, suggesting the story is still early in gaining community attention.
fundamentals_table: Nearly debt-free (Rs 23 Cr borrowings vs Rs 396 Cr total assets)
33.88% (Jun 2026), sharply up from 23.06% earlier in the same fiscal year
Sales Rs 67.64 Cr, Net Profit Rs 4.79 Cr, EPS Rs 2.00
fundamentals_narrative: Explosive recent growth (85% 3-year and 70% TTM sales CAGR, 273% TTM profit growth) is the headline, but ROE/ROCE remain very low (3-4%), meaning the company isn't yet converting that growth into efficient returns on capital - a real gap between top-line momentum and bottom-line quality. The promoter stake jump from 23.06% to 33.88% within a single fiscal year is a notable, verifiable confidence signal (likely a preferential allotment or open-market buying by parent Aurionpro). Working capital reportedly improved dramatically (800 to 76 days per Screener) - a huge swing that, while positive on its face, is unusual enough to warrant independent verification rather than taking at face value.
